2608.27066.title: Beyond Classification: Task-Dependent Learnability under Privacy-Motivated Image Transformations
2608.27066.paper_summary: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) in computer vision often rely on noise or image perturbations to protect visual data while securely processing it, creating a trade-off between task performance and protection. This trade-off is commonly evaluated using image classification, which primarily captures semantic separability and remains robust despite significant geometric, spatial layout or local boundary alterations. As a result, it is too simplistic as a proxy for generic vision tasks. Exhaustive downstream-task evaluation, however, is computationally expensive because models must often be trained for each PET transformation and parameter setting. We therefore propose a compute-aware multi-task protocol for evaluating PETs in model training. It combines lightweight proxy tasks that target complementary aspects of visual structure while remaining simple and fast to compute. Across irreversible privacy transformations, key-based block primitives, and learnable image encryption schemes, we demonstrate that PETs with similar classification accuracy can differ substantially on other tasks. The outcomes highlight the need for PET evaluation protocols that move beyond classification-only reporting.
2608.27066.paper_summary_zh: 隱私增強技術（PETs）在計算機視覺中通常依賴噪音或圖像擾動來保護視覺數據，同時安全地處理它，這在任務性能和保護之間創造了一個權衡。這種權衡通常通過圖像分類來評估，該方法主要捕捉語義可分性，並且在面對顯著的幾何、空間佈局或局部邊界變化時仍然保持穩健。因此，這對於一般視覺任務來說過於簡化。 然而，徹底的下游任務評估在計算上是昂貴的，因為模型通常必須為每個PET變換和參數設置進行訓練。因此，我們提出了一種計算感知的多任務協議，用於在模型訓練中評估PETs。它結合了針對視覺結構互補方面的輕量級代理任務，同時保持簡單和快速計算。在不可逆的隱私變換、基於密鑰的區塊原語和可學習的圖像加密方案中，我們展示了具有相似分類準確性的PETs在其他任務上可能存在顯著差異。這些結果突顯了需要超越僅僅分類報告的PET評估協議。
